description.value: Betterbite is an Asian fusion takeout spot in Richmond specializing in dumplings, wontons, and hand-crafted flour-based dishes under its Chinese name 不二包. Located in a strip mall unit on Leslie Road, it offers online ordering and a menu rooted in Northern Chinese street-food traditions. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond's commercial corridors would find it a convenient stop for a quick, filling meal.

The address (8171 Leslie Rd #110, Richmond, BC V6X1E4) and phone (+1 778-636-0119) are confirmed from the website; OSM had no phone listed.
